mandatory_excel_currency_rules: User-facing prices use only CNY/¥ or EUR/€.
All non-CNY source prices used in the workbook are converted to EUR/€ at export time.
No USD/GBP/JPY/TWD/HKD or other currencies appear in the user-facing workbook.
FX conversion date/source is retained when conversion occurs.
Source market and evidence status remain visible so converted EUR values are not mistaken for European-market or China-market native quotes.
other_mandatory_excel_rules: Use CRM-M ID label as 选品材料ID, never canonical ID.
Do not fill inventory offsets or procurement quantity from unavailable canonical/inventory sources.
Purchase approval remains zero and the workbook is not an order instruction.
next_user_facing_step: Generate Excel only after pre-Excel audit confirms the CNY/EUR-only policy is applied consistently.
